project.name: mpips
project.description: Reusable Madeena image-processing execution microservice for DAG-based scientific image processing.
project.service_boundary: MPIPS executes image-processing DAGs for Madeena clients. It owns FastAPI job/catalog endpoints, Celery execution, image node implementations, S3-compatible object storage IO, Redis-backed job state, IQA metadata, and signed webhook callbacks. Calling applications own users, visual builders, billing, user-facing image serving, and business metadata.

backend.package_manager: uv lockfile present; standard pip editable install supported

frontend.type: none; backend-only service with API documentation endpoints

database.runtime_state: Redis stores Celery state and mpips:job:* status snapshots
database.object_storage: S3-compatible storage via boto3, including MinIO-compatible AWS_ENDPOINT_URL

infrastructure.container: Dockerfile based on python:3.12-slim with API and worker roles
infrastructure.deployment_constraint: Use CI/CD or committed configuration only; direct SSH is prohibited

modules.mpips/api: FastAPI application, branded docs, root, health, secure-test, versioned routes, schemas, and security.
modules.mpips/engine/dag.py: Topological sort and DAG execution engine with temp file cleanup, storage backend IO, output metadata, and IQA metrics.
modules.mpips/engine/registry.py: Node class lookup and IO node adapters.
modules.mpips/engine/calibration: Promoted reusable calibration helpers such as warp_image.
modules.mpips/storage.py: S3-compatible, presigned URL, and local-file storage backends.
modules.mpips/tenant_paths.py: Tenant prefix validation for input and output storage paths.
modules.mpips/worker: Celery app configuration, run_pipeline task, Redis state updates, webhook dispatch, cancellation behavior.
modules.tests: Pytest suite for API, Celery/webhooks, DAG, image nodes, scientific nodes, security, storage, package imports, and root endpoint.
modules.research/camera-calibration-dotgrid: Bundled calibration research/prototype artifacts, data, references, outputs, and scripts; not part of packaged MPIPS service.
modules.research/imager-pipeline: Bundled legacy/prototype image pipeline scripts; not part of packaged MPIPS service.
